name: 新 HSK 四级（3.0）
note: New HSK (3.0) format from the official 2026 sample paper: 70 questions, about 85 minutes. The speaking paper (HSK四级口语) is separate. Section scores out of 100 and the 180 pass mark are estimates; the new pass mark has not been published.

sections.name: 听力 Listening
sections.intro: 大家好！欢迎参加HSK四级考试。HSK四级听力考试分两部分，共32题。请大家注意，听力考试现在开始。

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.desc: 选词填空。请注意：其中一个选项为干扰项，需排除。

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.rubric:
Score 0-10:
10 = target word used correctly; sentence clearly describes the picture; grammatical and natural; richer than the bare minimum
8 = correct and relevant but very simple, or one minor slip (wrong measure word, missing 了, one wrong character)
5 = target word used and relevant, but noticeable grammar errors that do not block meaning
2 = target word misused, or sentence barely relates to the picture, or serious errors
0 = blank, target word missing, or unintelligible
Deduct 1 for each wrongly written character (错别字), minimum 0.

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.prompt: 请写一篇不少于80字的短文。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-50 (new HSK 4 short essay on the given topic, at least 80 characters; count every character incl. punctuation, as on the answer sheet):
45-50 = fully on topic; clear beginning, details and ending; varied HSK 4-level vocabulary and grammar used correctly; almost no errors; 80+ characters
35-44 = on topic and coherent; some minor grammar or word-choice errors; length about right
25-34 = on topic but thin or loosely organised; several errors that rarely block meaning
12-24 = only partly on topic, or many errors that sometimes block meaning, or well under 60 characters
1-11 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).
